# Use the DualSense® Wireless Controller features

Use the following pages to understand and implement the features of the DualSense Wireless Controller using the PS5 Input System package.


|**Topic**|**Description**|
|---|---|
|[**Trigger effects**](trigger-effects.md)|Add effects and resistance to the triggers in the PS5 controller.|
|[**Vibration**](vibration.md)|Add physical feedback to your title using vibration.|
|[**Touchpad**](touchpad.md)|Understand how to access and use the DualSense touchpad.|
|[**Motion sensors**](motion-sensors.md)|Access data from the in-built accelerometer and gyroscope.|
|[**Light bar**](light-bar.md)|Update and use the DualSense light bar.|
|[**Controller information**](controller-information.md)|Access information about each active controller.|

> [!NOTE]
> The following features are only supported when running on PS5 hardware and aren't available in the Unity Editor:
> - Touchpad touch infomation
> - Motion Sensor infomation
> - Lightbar
